This young '''Jedi''' was a young brown-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She trained alongside [[Jedi Master|Masters]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Kirlocca]] at the [[Almas Academy]]. She wielded an orange-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during combat.
